reason: Free listing costs me nothing so I'd probably let them load my flyers, but I wouldn't pay anything. 500 signups is not a crowd, and my students already find my nights on Instagram, which works well enough for me.
objection: I'd want to see real results before paying anything. 500 people on a waitlist isn't customers in my room, and I don't know if app users are my students or if they'd show up at the door.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app live with real monthly users in my city and proof from another venue that it actually brought people through the door on a music night.
